# Elite Performance

> > Mental performance coaching for athletes to excel under pressure, led by Rob Kelly in Ireland.

Elite Performance is a sports psychology coaching practice specializing in pressure management and mental training for individual athletes and teams. Rob Kelly offers personalized programs, hypnosis recordings, and evidence-based techniques to help athletes build confidence and perform optimally in high-stakes competition.

## Key Topics

- Performance Psychology
- Pressure Management
- Mental Performance Coaching
- Sports Hypnosis
- Confidence Building
- Athlete Training
- GAA & Rugby
- Teenage Sports Anxiety
- Nervous System Regulation
- Subconscious Mind Training
- Mental Performance Routine
- Rob Kelly
- Elite Performance Pressure Signature™
- FEPSAC
- Performance Anxiety

## Core Services

- [Help Athletes Perform Under Pressure](https://www.eliteperformance.ie): Homepage for Elite Performance Psychology Ireland, Rob Kelly's mental coaching for athletes.
- [About Rob Kelly](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/about-rob-kelly): About page introducing performance psychology coach Rob Kelly and credentials.
- [Plans & Pricing](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/plans-pricing): Coaching packages and pricing for Rob Kelly's mental performance programs.

## Specialized Coaching Programs

- [Team Performance Psychology for GAA & Rugby](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/team-performance): Team performance psychology services for GAA and Rugby teams in Ireland.
- [Teenage Sports Anxiety & Confidence](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/www-eliteperformance-ie-teen-sport-confidence): Specialized mental coaching for teenage athletes managing competition anxiety.
- [Pressure Performance Reset Program](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/pressure-performance-reset): Personalized mental performance reset program for athletes to build focus and confidence.

## Mental Training Methods

- [Mental Performance Routine](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/mental-performance-routine): Guide to 7-minute pre-performance mental routine for athletes under pressure.
- [Subconscious Mind Training for Athletes](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/subconscious-performance-training): Subconscious training methods for athletes to execute with confidence and flow.
- [Sports Hypnosis Library](https://www.eliteperformance.ie/sports-hypnosis-library): Audio library of sports hypnosis recordings for athlete mental performance training.
